objective: Maintain the inference SLO while increasing concurrent request capacity.

autoscaling_signals.action: Scale out when sustained concurrency approaches the configured operating threshold.
Scale out before p95 approaches the 100.0 ms SLO.
Scale out or fail safe when error rate approaches 1.0%.
Use sustained CPU utilization as a supporting infrastructure signal.

batching.recommendation: Enable micro-batching only if queueing delay remains inside the p95 latency SLO.

model_cache.requirement: Load the model once per worker/replica instead of loading it for every request.

action: route traffic only to ready replicas
return MODEL_UNAVAILABLE safe fallback when inference is unavailable

devops_handoff: Configure autoscaling using concurrency and latency signals.
Keep the 30% headroom policy unless production measurements justify another value.
